\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-81},
  title = {Coding agents work under a written team rule},
  date = {2026-09-29 (rule written down); review rule reworded on 2026-10-12 and confirmed on 2026-10-13},
  milestone = {Other (team process)},
  topic = {Use of AI Coding Agents, Code Review},
  participants = {@lukas2510 wrote the rule down and proposed the rewording; the full team confirmed it at the laboratory session of 2026-10-13; no earlier discussion of the rule by the other four members is on record},
  decision = {Agents write and review most changes, people decide and are accountable, and no person signs off each pull request.
The rule is one of four in the \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/scrum/working-agreements.md}{working agreements}, and its review clause, reworded on 2026-10-12, reads: ``Agent-written code goes through the same pull request as anything else. An independent agent with a fresh context reviews every substantive change by reproducing its claims and trying to break it, and the required checks gate the merge. A person decides the questions that belong in the EDN and is accountable for the change.''},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Keep the old wording, ``The reviewer is a person'': a rule the team does not follow.
\item A second person approves every pull request: GitHub blocks approving one's own, and an agent's runs under its author's account, so most merges would wait.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The rule now says what the trace shows: of the 56 pull requests merged by 2026-10-11, 2 carry a review by another person, and branch protection requires 9 checks and 0 approvals.
People decide: of the 76 original entries EDN-01 to EDN-78, the AI's proposal was accepted in 46, modified in 27, rejected in 2 and used as input in 1; of the 35 kept after the trim, in 23, 9, 1 and 1, with EDN-25 rejected and then partly adopted.
Comments and pull requests under a member's account are often typed by an agent on that member's instruction, and the member answers for them.
The weak spot: 48 of the 56 were opened and merged under one account without a second person's review, so in sprint 3 every teammate opens the pull request for their own ticket.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {The rule's text is AI's, adopted by @lukas2510 on 2026-09-29.
On 2026-10-12 AI measured the numbers above, found that the review rule and the trace disagreed, and recommended the rewording, which @lukas2510 chose.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-21, 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-12.},
